validate-package-install-distribution.default_behavior: public action injects --from-nothing when no pass-through arguments are supplied

model_rules: clean install validation must remove its owned install root before materializing package evidence
installed package manifests must byte-equivalently project from generated package manifests and keep lock manifest digests
installed package order must preserve the dependency-first resolution plan from the generated package lock
update and uninstall operation receipts must be deterministic, digest-bound to the locked package graph, and stored under the clean install receipt root
update receipts preserve dependency-first package order while uninstall receipts use reverse dependency order
local package install artifacts must digest-bind source manifests, installed manifests, lock manifest digests, and trust signatures

install distribution consumes hosted registry, hermetic hosted service, and network publication only as checked-in offline fixture contracts; live network install and fallback registry success remain fail-closed

clean install materialization must validate extraction plan path safety, duplicate and case-conflicting paths, symlink rejection, installer/update-key policy hooks, and reserved release/registry trust roots before filesystem mutation
release manifest input contracts must exclude generated report paths and consume tmp/artifacts install proof records instead
public package install distribution support truth must name the from-nothing replay command and must not present a generated report as source authority
installed package sources, lock entries, mirror entries, local registry entries, publication metadata, and restore receipt counts must agree
offline mirror cache entries must digest-match the lock-derived mirror index before an install claim can pass

install receipts must be machine-generated under the package ecosystem validation root, validate against the package-ecosystem install distribution receipt schema, publish the objc3c package bridge, and name the from-nothing public replay command
update and uninstall receipts must use the package-ecosystem install distribution operation receipt schema instead of the package operation schema used by publish/install/update/rollback operations
network install, live public hosted registry, and alternate package-manager claims remain fail-closed until separate evidence exists

blocking_conditions: clean install root depends on stale preexisting artifacts
install receipt missing or not machine-owned
package manifest, lock, mirror, registry, publication, or restore metadata disagree
offline mirror cache entry missing or digest-mismatched
from-nothing install proof manifest missing or report-derived release input accepted
hosted registry or network install claim widened without evidence
hosted registry or network fixture metadata accepted live network or fallback registry success during install distribution
install distribution filesystem mutation occurred before extraction path safety proof
install distribution accepted active release or registry trust roots without source-owned security hardening contract
public package install validation action missing from objc3c bridge
generated install evidence escaped the package ecosystem artifact root

claim_boundary: clean local package install credibility only: checked-in source contracts generate package manifests, a deterministic lock, an offline mirror, local registry metadata, offline hosted/service/network/release-channel fixture inputs, an extraction safety plan, an install receipt, and a clean-root verification record; live hosted registry access, live network dependency resolution, fallback registry success, system installer publication, and remote release-channel operations remain outside this contract
